name: Santini
verdict: Santini Spa's sole shareholder (socio unico) is Vibria Srl; the UCI describes Santini as an Italian family company founded by Pietro Santini. Nothing found.
note: Italian cycling-apparel maker; Lidl-Trek's kit supplier since 2017 (Trek-Segafredo era). Rated none: the only state-less ownership found; who owns Vibria Srl itself is not published on the pages checked - see PR.
